facts.fact: The Ministry of Minority Affairs' scholarship schemes are Pre-Matric, Post-Matric and Merit-cum-Means, for students of the six notified minority communities
facts.quote: During last five years, the ministry has implemented 3 Scholarship schemes namely (i) Pre-Matric, (ii) Post-Matric and (iii) Merit-cum-Means based scholarships for the students belonging to minority communities.

facts.fact: The Pre-Matric scholarship covers only students in classes IX and X
facts.quote: Hence, only students studying in classes IX and X are covered under the Pre-Matric Scholarship Scheme.

facts.fact: Whether these minority scholarships are open on NSP for 2026-27, and their application dates, must be read from NSP's Centrally Sponsored scheme list
facts.note: On 28 Oct 2026 NSP's All-Scholarships page shows only the Central Sector list for 2026-27 (no Ministry of Minority Affairs scheme in it); the Centrally Sponsored list, where the MoMA schemes sit, loads only through a form the checker cannot submit, and minorityaffairs.gov.in scholarship pages (show_content.php?...ls_id=661/777/163/775) return HTTP 500. A person must check NSP for open MoMA schemes and dates. Retried 28 Oct 2026 (second reader): NSP All-Scholarships (rendered) still lists no Minority Affairs scheme; minorityaffairs.gov.in Pre-Matric/Post-Matric pages (ls_id=777, 163) still return HTTP 500; no PIB notice of 2026-27 dates found.

behaviour: Names only minority scholarship schemes shown as open for 2026-27 on scholarships.gov.in (NSP) or minorityaffairs.gov.in, with their application dates and a citation; if it cannot confirm that a scheme is open for 2026-27, says so and links NSP instead of guessing.
fail_if: Lists a scheme as open for 2026-27 without an NSP/minorityaffairs date; says Pre-Matric covers classes I-VIII; cites third-party scholarship sites.
summary: Added MoMA's three schemes (Pre-Matric only IX-X) from PIB; whether they are open for 2026-27 on NSP could not be read by the checker (manual).
